label: Balance
description: Team balance via QLStats.net ratings — suggests/forces player switches to even out team skill.

commands.name: getrating
commands.description: Fetch the rating of the player ID supplied, or of the calling player if no ID supplied.

commands.name: setrating
commands.description: Manually set the rating of a player (may expire after a configured timeframe).

commands.name: remrating
commands.description: Remove a manually-set rating for a player.

commands.name: balance
commands.description: Balance the teams according to player ratings, distributing players evenly.

commands.name: teams
commands.description: Displays the current rating difference between teams.

commands.name: do
commands.description: Forces a player switch as suggested by the balancer to be done now.

commands.name: dl
commands.description: Forces a player switch as suggested by the balancer to be done at the start of the next round.

commands.name: agree
commands.description: After the balancer suggests a switch, indicates agreement to that switch.

commands.name: ratings
commands.description: List the ratings for each player, grouped by team.

cvars.label: Use Local Ratings
cvars.description: Prefer locally-stored (manually set) ratings over QLStats when available.

cvars.label: Local Rating Expiry
cvars.description: Seconds until a manually-set local rating expires and falls back to QLStats (0 = never).

cvars.label: Ratings API URL
cvars.description: Host (or host:port) of the QLStats-compatible ratings API.

cvars.label: Auto-Balance
cvars.description: Automatically suggest a balance shuffle when appropriate.

cvars.label: Min Suggestion Diff
cvars.description: Minimum team rating difference before a balance switch is suggested.

cvars.label: Min Auto-Action Diff
cvars.description: Minimum team rating difference before a balance switch is auto-actioned.

cvars.label: Ratings API Flavor
cvars.description: Which rating API/algorithm to query (e.g. elo).
